caption:
Uninstalling leaves a gap in what an app can observe.

If prices change while India Prior Price is removed, it cannot record those changes. Keeping an old record does not tell us what happened during the gap.

After reinstalling, fresh recorded history is needed before a later eligible price reduction can show the observed prior price. Old records do not fill the gap.

Only recorded prices are used. Coming soon. Follow for launch.
